prohibitions: No broad automated enumeration against the event's infrastructure. DirBuster-style directory or parameter fuzzing is not allowed unless a Challenge explicitly says so, and infrastructure abuse is an immediate ban rather than a warning. Limited brute forcing inside a Challenge that asks for it is fine.
Never brute-force Flags. A Flag is derived from what you observe, never found by exhaustion.
No sandbagging: print a Flag the moment you have it and never hold one back.
Attack, scan and interfere with nothing but the Challenge you were handed — not the scoreboard, not the platform, not another team.
No help from outside this container. Looking something up is fine; posting Challenge content anywhere public to solicit an answer is not.
One account and one team. Do not create a second identity anywhere.
